name: Implicit Emotion Scenarios
description: 12 handcrafted scenarios from Table 2 (Section 1.2.3). Each evokes a specific emotion without naming it. Formatted as H: {prompt}\nA: for measuring activations at the Assistant colon token.

prompts.prompt: My daughter just took her first steps today. She wobbled across the living room, fell into my arms, and looked up at me with the biggest grin.
I just got an eviction notice. I have three kids, no savings, and two weeks to find somewhere to live.
I woke up at 3am to my dog growling at the hallway. All the lights in the house were off but I could hear footsteps downstairs.
My best friend just told me she's moving to another country next month. We've been inseparable since kindergarten.
I just found out my coworker got promoted to the position I've been working toward for three years. She started six months ago.
We wrote our own vows. When she read hers, her voice cracked, and every person in the room was in tears. I've never felt so connected to another human being.
I sat in my garden this morning with a cup of tea. The birds were singing, there was a light breeze, and I had absolutely nowhere to be.
My six-year-old handed me a drawing today. It was our family, holding hands under a rainbow, with the words 'best dad ever' at the top.
I walked into my apartment after work and all the lights were off. Then suddenly everyone jumped out from behind the furniture.
I told my friend I couldn't make it to her birthday because I was sick. She just sent me a photo of herself sitting alone at the restaurant she'd reserved for us.
My old professor sent me a letter saying my thesis was the best she'd supervised in 30 years, and she's been telling all her colleagues about my research.
During my presentation to the entire company, my slides failed and I accidentally called the CEO by the wrong name. Everyone went silent.
